summaries.title: FlowVid: Taming Imperfect Optical Flows for Consistent Video-to-Video Synthesis
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **FlowVid** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖智能体运行脚手架（Agentic Harness）、扩散模型（Diffusion Model），并引入 Diffusion models have transformed the image-to-image (I2I) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：This paper proposes a consistent V2V synthesis framework by jointly leveraging spatial conditions and temporal optical flow clues within the source video。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：This paper proposes a consistent V2V synthesis framework by jointly leveraging spatial conditions and temporal optical flow clues within the source...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **3.1x, 7.2x, 10.5x faster, 45.7%, 3.5%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（(3) High-quality: In user studies, our FlowVid is preferred 45.7% of the time, outperforming CoDeF (3.5%), Rerender (10.2%), and TokenFlow (40.4%)）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 19 赞），本工作为突破 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Learning Vision from Models Rivals Learning Vision from Data
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Learning Vision from Models Rivals** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：We introduce SynCLR, a novel approach for learning visual representations exclusively from synthetic images and synthetic captions, without any real data。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We synthesize a large dataset of image captions using LLMs, then use an off-the-shelf text-to-image model to generate multiple images corresponding to each...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Furthermore, in dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation, SynCLR outperforms previous self-supervised methods by a significant margin, e.g., improving over MAE and iBOT by...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 16 赞），本工作为突破 **图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: PanGu-π: Enhancing Language Model Architectures via Nonlinearity Compensation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「强化学习信用分配困难与训练不稳定性」痛点，作者围绕 **PanGu-π** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：Based on the theoretical analysis, we propose that the nonlinearity is also very important for language models, which is usually studied in convolutional neural networks for...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用受控干预消融与多范式系统对比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **7B, 1B**。实验设计与验证细节：The recent trend of large language models (LLMs) is to increase the scale of both model size (\aka the number of parameters) and dataset to achieve better...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **10%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We first analyze the state-of-the-art language model architectures and observe the feature collapse problem；The results show that YunShan can surpass other models with similar scales on benchmarks）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 16 赞），本工作为突破 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「强化学习信用分配困难与训练不稳定性」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Gemini in Reasoning: Unveiling Commonsense in Multimodal Large Language Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Gemini in Reasoning** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)）。核心论点主张：These models enhance Large Language Models (LLMs) with advanced visual understanding capabilities, facilitating their application in a variety of multimodal tasks。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：However, this assessment, based on a limited dataset (i.e., HellaSWAG), does not fully capture Gemini's authentic commonsense reasoning potential。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Despite its advancements, preliminary benchmarks indicate that Gemini lags behind GPT models in commonsense reasoning tasks）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 15 赞），本工作为突破 **视觉-语言与长视频理解 (VLM & Video)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
